items.desc: Unified customer portal: service booking, electrical product catalog browsing, cart, instant checkout, address & location pincode check, and live service/order tracking.
Intuitive appointment scheduler for home/commercial electrical services (wiring, fan/light fittings, MCB repair, inverters). Slot picker, emergency service toggle, and upfront estimation.
Product catalog with categories (Switches, Sockets, Wires & Cables, MCBs, LED Lighting, Inverter Batteries, Tools). Product variants, stock status, and specifications sheet.
Integrated Razorpay checkout: Direct UPI intent (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit/debit cards, net banking, plus Cash on Delivery (COD) / Pay-after-Service workflow.
Centralized operations portal: incoming service requests queue, technician dispatch & scheduling, product inventory CRUD, banner management, and sales summaries.
Field technician interface: assigned work orders, customer click-to-call, GPS direction navigation, status updates (On the way, In-progress, Completed), and digital signature/receipt.
Multi-stage live tracking: Request Placed → Technician Assigned → Work in Progress → Completed / Order Delivered. Automated SMS/WhatsApp notifications.
Full bilingual support in Tamil and English with instant language toggle. All service labels, categories, and notifications adapt to the selected language.
Firebase Phone OTP authentication, profile dashboard, multiple saved service addresses (Home, Office, Shop), and historical booking records with downloadable invoices.
Admin-managed promotional banners, seasonal discounts, festival coupon codes, and announcement tickers across customer screens.
Cloud Firestore real-time database, Firebase Auth, Cloud Storage for service completion photos, and Firebase Hosting with SSL certificate — first year FREE.

bullets.text: Rs.1,299/year (approx. Rs.108/month) — Specially discounted maintenance package structured exclusively for Electrical Vibers.
Covers Firestore reads/writes, real-time booking synchronization, product image hosting, and SSL certificate renewals.
Covers Android OS compatibility updates, Ionic/Angular security patches, and minor UI adjustments.
Commercial service-booking platforms typically incur Rs.8,000–Rs.15,000/year in vendor maintenance. Flow's nominal Rs.1,299/year rate represents a long-term partnership commitment.
Annual fee of Rs.1,299 will apply from the 13th month onwards, payable annually.
Rs.40,000 INR for complete design, engineering, and handover of the working application.
50% advance (Rs.20,000) received and acknowledged; remaining 50% (Rs.20,000) due upon final delivery & staff handover.
Firebase cloud hosting and database provisioning are 100% FREE for the first 12 months from delivery date, compliments of Flow.
Annual maintenance & cloud renewal fee of Rs.1,299/year will apply from the 13th month onwards.
All bugs, crashes, and performance issues reported within 12 months will be resolved at zero additional charge.
Any new third-party integrations (e.g. automated IVR calling, custom accounting software sync) outside the agreed 12 modules will be quoted separately.
Bug fixes, security patches, framework compatibility updates, and monitoring from delivery date to delivery date + 12 months.
Direct WhatsApp and phone assistance via +91 8903424281 during business hours (Mon–Sat, 9 AM – 6 PM IST).
Customer loyalty points, electrician rating & reviews, recurring AMC electrical service contracts, and automated WhatsApp order alerts.
All customer profiles, service records, and catalog data belong 100% to Electrical Vibers. Flow provides full data export upon request.
